metadata.description: gearbox: per-prompt model and effort for Claude Code, with an orchestrator that hands the work to cheaper agents

plugins.name: gearbox
plugins.description: Per-prompt model and effort for Claude Code. By default an orchestrator keeps the main conversation on the model you picked for the session (Opus, Fable, any) to plan, brief and review, runs the work in one long-lived agent per model and splits independent parts across up to 6 agents at once; browser checks, long commands and git chores go to cheap subagents; and a live readout shows every agent's model.
